mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 8% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE exceeds 8% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS declines for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO declines for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 8% combined with a decline in payroll employment signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 8.0% for 3 consecutive months AND PAYEMS falls for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when both UNRATE exceeds 8% and PAYEMS declines for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand and housing activity, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls for 3 consecutive months AND HOUST falls for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production combined with a decline in real GDP signals weakening manufacturing and overall economic activity, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls for 3 consecutive months AND GDPC1 falls for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline for three months (t-test p > 0.05).
